title: JJK Clans & Schools
description: Big Three Clans, Tokyo and Kyoto Jujutsu Highs, and Culling Game!

questions.question: Which three families make up the Big Three Sorcerer Clans?
questions.explanation: The Gojo, Zenin, and Kamo families are the Big Three Clans of jujutsu society.

questions.question: Which clan inherits the Ten Shadows Technique?
questions.explanation: Ten Shadows is the Zenin family's inherited technique, used by Megumi Fushiguro.

questions.question: The Six Eyes and Limitless techniques only manifest together once every few centuries.
questions.explanation: The combination of Six Eyes and Limitless is exceedingly rare, with Gojo being the first in 400 years.

questions.question: What is the Culling Game?

options.text: A tournament between Tokyo and Kyoto schools
Kenjaku's ritual that traps sorcerers in death-match colonies

questions.explanation: Kenjaku activates the Culling Game across colonies of incarnated ancient sorcerers and modern humans.

questions.question: Who is the immortal star plasma vessel keeping Tengen tethered to humanity?

options.text: Tengen merges with a Star Plasma Vessel periodically

questions.explanation: Tengen periodically merges with a Star Plasma Vessel to avoid evolving past humanity; Riko was a candidate.

questions.question: The Goodwill Event is a yearly competition between Tokyo and Kyoto Jujutsu High.
questions.explanation: The Goodwill Event pits the two schools' students against each other in team-based events.

questions.question: Which Kyoto sorcerer briefly serves as a translator-themed support?
questions.explanation: Utahime is a Kyoto assistant supervisor whose cursed song amplifies allies.

questions.question: The Tokyo Jujutsu High first-year curriculum includes mandatory missions exorcising real cursed spirits.
questions.explanation: First-year sorcerers go on grade-rated missions almost immediately upon enrollment.

questions.question: Which clan once tried to control the Death Painting wombs?
questions.explanation: Kenjaku, possessing the original Noritoshi Kamo, created the Death Painting Wombs experiments.

questions.question: What is the maximum grade for a cursed object/cursed tool classification?
questions.explanation: Special grade is the highest classification, matching the sorcerer grading system.
